lesson: The system is consistently attempting to fade macro trends with low-confidence counter-trend entries that fail to respect structural BOS. Every trade was stopped out because the entries relied on localized liquidity sweeps that were immediately invalidated by the dominant bearish momentum.
adjustment: Implement a strict 'Trend Alignment Filter' that mandates a minimum 60% confidence score and prohibits counter-trend entries unless a confirmed 4h CHoCH is present.
methodology_flag: Trust SMC liquidity sweeps less in a strong bearish regime; prioritize EMA alignment over localized price action.
